summary: The proof correctly derives the two chord-width bounds from the high-high area constraint, factors and bounds both cross terms to obtain the strict shape-budget inequality, converts the resulting depth alternative into the claimed clipped-area lower bound via planar Brunn-Minkowski, verifies the numerical comparison, and applies the accepted triangle-family estimates with the correct strictness and constants. All positivity, compactness, boundary, scaling, and specialization requirements are satisfied.
